shared_elements: human figure(s) rendered in low relief
justification: Both surfaces carry human forms and a prominent circular element rendered in shallow relief with incised linear detail, but these are the most generic possible correspondences. A is a single frontal, massively schematic figure with symmetrical body markings and no narrative, while B is a multi-figure profile narrative of a chariot, horses, archers and a landscape ground line — different subject, composition and level of naturalism entirely.
